'''Ghetto 6 Ghetto 6's White Boardered Madness''' is the [[Light]] constructed list Ghetto 6 posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-17720">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17720 Ghetto 6's White Boardered Madness], DeckTech (Ghost "Ghetto 6" Face, 23 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17720/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17720/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Ghetto 6
* '''Published:''' 23 July 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Ghetto 6's White Boardered Madness''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]

* '''Strategy:''' Oh Hell yeah, This thing went 0-3 in a tourney, just as expected of a deck with 52 chars, half of them being rebel troopers.

== Original post ==

'''Ghetto 6's White Boardered Madness'''
* '''Author:''' Ghost "Ghetto 6" Face
* '''Published:''' July 23, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Oh Hell yeah, This thing went 0-3 in a tourney, just as expected of a deck with 52 chars, half of them being rebel troopers.

=== Strategy ===

The Bleeped one is F*ggot A$$ F*ggot, if you couldn't tell. Ok, the Tournament was going fine(me losing every game as expected) till I brought this monster against TJ's Chyna deck, and bladow, the Dark Lord gets hit by the Pedigree.  So, Gangsta B*tch and Afro Puff hop onto Silver Surfer as passengers and pull a drive by on her loppy a$$.

And, all but 4 cards(Ben Kenobi, Careful Planning, Ardon 'Vapor' Crell, and the Foil Dark Lord) were white boardered. If you want to see the 3P0 Family, look for them on the Ghetto Squad page, pictures of all but Indian Chief are there.
